title: Entity catalog
responsibility: Groups and searches catalog entities; configs get a separate table per source file while other kinds retain responsibility categories.

inputs.name: ExplorerIndex.category
inputs.description: The registry category that selects its heading and category-specific content; it also controls whether rows are grouped and whether the component-level selector appears.

inputs.name: ExplorerIndex.rows
inputs.description: The complete catalog rows for this category at the shown revision, before this component filters them. An empty array renders the empty-registry state.

inputs.name: ExplorerIndex.scope
inputs.description: An optional scope string included in the reset key passed to each HarnessGroup, alongside category, filters, and component composition. Defaults to the empty string.

inputs.name: ExplorerIndex.list
inputs.description: The required Svelte snippet that renders row arrays: it receives each displayed section’s rows when sections are present, or the filtered rows otherwise.

outputs.name: ExplorerIndex
outputs.description: Renders category headings and controls, a count status, and the supplied list, grouping eligible categories into nonempty sections (configs by source file and other grouped categories by responsibility group, with ungrouped rows last). Empty registries and zero matches show separate states; the zero-match state offers Show all, which resets the composition selector and search/filter fields.

errors.name: Caller callback or content error
errors.description: An exception thrown by the supplied list snippet while rendering is not caught by this component and propagates through the render.

inputs.name: configSections.rows
inputs.description: The catalog rows to partition into source-file sections. Rows with configFile use its source and title; other rows derive a source from the setting, first owned source path, or entity id, and empty input returns no sections.

outputs.name: configSections
outputs.description: Source-file sections with their rows, sorted by title and then id; source is optional.

inputs.name: catalogSections.rows
inputs.description: Rows assigned to their group id and title, or to the uncategorized section when no group exists; input order is retained within each section.

outputs.name: catalogSections
outputs.description: One section per group, with input order preserved within each rows array; titles use English base-sensitivity collation and the uncategorized section sorts last.

inputs.name: catalogGroups.rows
inputs.description: The rows to group and count. Each count reflects the number of rows in its section, so callers pass the complete catalog when counts should remain available during filtering.

outputs.name: catalogGroups
outputs.type: Array<{ id: string; title: string; count: number }>
outputs.description: Section ids and titles with row counts, in catalogSections order; an uncategorized entry appears only when an input row has no group.
